purpose: Determine whether a longitudinal Antarctic test of terrestrial breeding-opportunity change versus penguin breeding-space change is technically identifiable before any demographic outcome is opened.
paper1_boundary: Do not modify, retune, or reopen the closed cross-scale concentration submission endpoints.

source_roster.primary: Reuse site identities, species labels, coordinates, record years, and observation-method metadata from the already-pinned MAPPPD snapshot used by the regional concentration branch.
allowed_demographic_fields: years with at least one candidate nest-count observation
prohibited_demographic_fields_during_aud: any label derived from whether abundance increased or declined

terrestrial_support.goal: Assess whether change in accessible ice-free breeding opportunity can be measured at each site without using demographic outcomes.
candidate_sources: Landsat archive for historical optical imagery
Sentinel-2 for recent optical imagery and validation
SCAR Antarctic Digital Database 2026 coastline / rock-outcrop geometry for QA only
terrestrial_support.warning: Do not estimate habitat change by naively differencing successive SCAR ADD releases because source dates vary among features.

marine_support.goal: Audit availability only; do not select predictors by correlation with demographic outcomes.
candidate_domains: distance or access cost to open water during breeding
remote-sensing productivity when temporal support is sufficient

staged_design: Stage A: build support table with prohibited demographic fields physically absent from the audit object.
Stage B: inspect only support and predictor-measurement quality; define deterministic eligibility and accessible-habitat metric.
Stage C: freeze the eligible roster, terrestrial metric, marine covariate set, model family, nulls, and stop rule in a separate outcome contract.
Stage D: only then join demographic magnitudes and breeding-space outcomes.
no_outcome_rule: This audit can conclude that Paper 2 is feasible or infeasible, but cannot report any association between habitat change and abundance, concentration, persistence, colonization, or extinction.
branch_stop_rule: If support is insufficient, stop Paper 2 without lowering thresholds after seeing demographic outcomes; proceed to the separately defined dynamic-substrate Paper 3 route.
